migration.schema.yaml.title: Blueprint Migration Schema
migration.schema.yaml.description: Versioned, ordered changes to a blueprint model instance. Enables AS-IS to TO-BE model transformation with traceability and rollback.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this migration conforms to. Omit to assume latest.

migration.description: Migration identity, lifecycle, and traceability metadata.

status.description: Lifecycle state: draft=authoring, pending=ready for review/application, applied=committed to model, rolled-back=reverted.

description.description: What this migration does and why, in plain language.

author.description: Person or agent who created this migration.

breaking.description: Whether this migration introduces breaking changes to generated artifacts.

semver_impact.description: Semantic versioning impact on the blueprint model version.

depends_on.description: Migrations that must be applied before this one. Loader validates dependency order.

related_decisions.description: Architectural decisions that motivated this migration.

rationale.description: Detailed reasoning for why this migration is needed.

tags.description: Free-form tags for grouping and filtering migrations.

properties.description: Open metadata bag for migration-level custom attributes.

changes.description: Model changes organized by concern: entities (nodes), properties (attributes), relationships (edges), and meta (cross-cutting). At least one change must be present across all collections.

entities.description: Entity-level changes: add, remove, deprecate, split, or merge entire blueprint entities.

properties.description: Property-level changes: set, unset, or rename individual fields on existing entities.

relationships.description: Relationship changes: add, remove, or redirect edges between entities.

meta.description: Cross-cutting changes: tags, file restructuring, bulk operations, constitution amendments.

rollback.description: Rollback feasibility metadata. Automatic rollback derives inverse operations from before/old_value.

automatic.description: Whether rollback can be computed from before/old_value fields.

data_loss.description: Whether rollback would lose information not captured in before/old_value.

external_actions.description: Manual actions required outside the blueprint if rollback is performed.

entity_change_kind.x-vocabulary-distinct: Names the OPERATION a migration performs on an entity, alongside a target and an ordering. Not the narrative impact classification a decision records.
entity_change_kind.description: What this migration does to one entity. add: a new entity. modify: replace it. deprecate: mark it for removal. remove: delete it. rename: it keeps its identity under a new id. split: one becomes many. merge: many become one. Deliberately NOT a reference to the metamodel's `change_kind`, which carries the same words to classify a decision's impact rather than to be executed.

entity_change.description: A change to a whole entity (node in the graph).

entity_type.description: Blueprint entity type. Routes validation to the appropriate schema.

target.description: Entity identifier (typed ref, e.g., CN005, CMD012) or SpecPath. For add: new entity ID. For merge: comma-separated source IDs.

before.description: Entity state before change. REQUIRED for modify, remove, merge. Enables rollback.

after.description: Entity state after change. REQUIRED for add, modify, split. For split: array of entities.

reason.description: Why this specific entity change is needed.

group.description: Atomic group name. All changes with the same group must apply together or not at all.

order.description: Explicit ordering within this migration. Lower numbers apply first.

property_change.description: A change to individual properties on an existing entity.

kind.description: Property operation: set=assign, unset=remove, rename=change name, append=add to array, remove-item=remove from array.

target.description: Entity identifier (typed ref, e.g., CN005, CMD012).

entity_type.description: Entity type for validation routing. Same enum as entity_change.entity_type.

property.description: Property name or dot-path for nested properties (e.g., description, payload.model).

value.description: New value for set/append operations. Type depends on the property.

old_value.description: Previous value for conflict detection and rollback.

new_name.description: New property name for rename operations.

description.description: Human-readable description of this property change.

reason.description: Why this property is being changed.

group.description: Atomic group name (same semantics as entity_change.group).

relationship_change.description: A change to a relationship (edge) between two entities.

kind.description: Edge operation: add=create, remove=delete, redirect=change target, modify=change edge properties.

subject.description: Source entity typed ref (e.g., CMD005). The entity this relationship originates from.

predicate.description: Relationship type. Maps to graph edge label.

object.description: Target entity typed ref (e.g., EVT006). For redirect: current target.

new_object.description: For redirect: the new target entity ref.

edge_properties.description: Properties on the edge itself (policy, condition, mode for produces/reacts_to).

relationship_type.description: DDD relationship pattern (for depends_on edges between contexts).

relationship.description: DDD context-map pattern carried on a context_depends_on edge.

direction.description: This context's role on a context_depends_on edge.

description.description: Human-readable description of this relationship change.

reason.description: Why this relationship is being changed.

meta_change.description: Cross-cutting changes: tags, file restructuring, bulk operations, constitution amendments.

kind.description: Meta operation: tag-add/remove/rename, bulk-tag, reclassify, move-to-slice, constitution-amend, declare-shared-layer, document-add/move/split/merge, or note (informational).

target.description: Entity ref, tag name, slice name, or constitution section depending on kind.

value.description: New value (tag name, new slice, amended text, etc.).

filter.description: For bulk operations: filter criteria to select target entities.

tags.description: Filter by existing tags (entities matching ANY).

layer.description: Filter by canonical model layer (e.g. design.ui, governance.roadmap).

reason.description: Why this meta change is needed.

migrations.schema.yaml.title: Blueprint Migration Register
migrations.schema.yaml.description: An ordered record of the changes a blueprint model has been through and the ones it is planned to go through, written for a reader. Each entry names one migration and describes its changes in prose. A single migration authored for execution, with typed targets and rollback data, is a `migration.yaml` document instead.

version.description: Version of the model instance this register describes.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this register conforms to. Omit to assume latest.

tags.description: Free-form tags for grouping and filtering the register.

migrations.description: The register, in the order the migrations apply. Completed and planned entries live in one list so a reader sees where the model has been and where it is going.

register_status.x-vocabulary-distinct: Says where a migration stands in the model's history, as a reader sees it. Not the authoring lifecycle of a single executable migration document, which runs draft to applied.
register_status.description: Where this migration stands. planned: intended, not yet carried out. in-progress: partly carried out. completed: carried out. cancelled: planned and then dropped, kept because the reason it was dropped is part of the history.

register_change_kind.x-vocabulary-distinct: Labels a change a reader is told about in prose, where naming an entity is optional. Not the operation an executable migration performs on a named target in a given order.
register_change_kind.description: What kind of change this entry describes. add: something new. modify: something changed. deprecate: something marked for removal. remove: something gone. rename: something kept its identity under a new name. split: one became many. merge: many became one.

id.description: Migration identifier (MIG001, MIG002, and so on).

name.description: Short title, in the words a reader of the model would use.

description.description: What this migration does and why, in plain language.

impact.description: Semantic versioning impact of this migration on the model version.

reversible.description: Whether this migration can be undone from what the entry records.

inverse_summary.description: How to undo this migration, in prose. Present when `reversible` is true and the steps are worth stating.

date.description: When this migration was carried out, or is planned for (YYYY-MM-DD).

depends_on.description: Migrations that apply before this one.

changes.description: The changes this migration makes, each described for a reader. An entry with no changes says nothing, so at least one is required.

register_change.description: One change a migration makes, described in prose. Naming the entity is optional: a change may describe a whole file, a slice or a convention, none of which carry an entity id.

description.description: What changed, in the words a reader of the model would use.

entity.description: The entity this change is about, when it is about one. A typed id, scoped where the model scopes ids.

reason.description: Why this particular change is part of the migration.

governance/decisions.schema.yaml.title: Blueprint Decisions
governance/decisions.schema.yaml.description: Governance Plane: Architecture Decision Log (ADR). Chronological, append-only record of design decisions with typed impact references, motivation traceability, and change-set analysis.

version.description: Content version. Bump minor for new decisions, patch for status updates.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this document conforms to. Omit to assume latest.

scope.description: Bounded context this decisions file belongs to. Enables filtering in multi-context blueprints.

owned_by.description: File-level ownership default. Entities inherit unless overridden.

decisions.description: Architecture Decision Log. Chronological, append-only. Each entry is immutable once landed - supersede rather than modify.

business_decisions.description: Bounded Context Canvas v5 business decisions (BD###). Distinct from `decisions[]` above: business_decisions are high-level policy statements governing a bounded context's behaviour, not ADRs. Optional; introduced in v2.6.3.

decision.description: An Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Minimum: id, title, summary, date, status, rationale.

id.description: Unique decision ID (e.g. DC001 or billing.DC001). Assigned chronologically; never reused.

title.description: Short descriptive title understandable without reading the full rationale.

summary.description: One-line summary for listings and quick scanning (≤200 chars). Self-contained.

date.description: Date proposed or accepted. Format: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Lifecycle status: open -> proposed -> rfc -> accepted -> landed; rejected or deprecated at any stage.

rationale.description: The reasoning behind this decision. Answers 'why' for future readers.

version.description: Decision version for individual lifecycle tracking.

decision_scope.description: The named scope this decision applies to: a slice (e.g. billing), a cross-cutting area that spans slices (e.g. integrations), or the whole system, named by the project's name. Unlike a file's `scope:`, it need not name a slice, so a decision in a file at the model root states its subject here.

motivation_refs.description: Motivation entities driving this decision: goals served, risks mitigated, assumptions, trade-offs accepted.

capability_refs.description: Business capabilities this decision supports or enables.

change_set.description: Machine-readable manifest of changes introduced. Each entry describes one blueprint element change.

declared_impact.description: Author's declaration of affected blueprint entities. Direct changes plus transitive ripple hints.

consequences.description: Known consequences of this decision: positive benefits and negative costs or technical debt.

positive.description: Benefits and improvements from this decision.

negative.description: Costs, limitations, or technical debt introduced.

acceptance.description: Conditions that must be met for this decision to be considered fully implemented.

links.description: External references: issue tracker, PRs, docs, and decision chain (supersedes/superseded_by).

discovery_stage.description: Epistemic maturity of this decision. Proposed decisions are typically hypothesis or exploring.

certainty.description: Confidence level of this decision. Speculative for proposed, confirmed for landed.

evidence.description: Evidence chain justifying this decision - benchmarks, experiments, stakeholder feedback.

rationale.description: The reasoning behind a decision: problem context, options explored, chosen approach.

problem.description: The problem or question that prompted this decision. Describes context and constraints.

options.description: Alternative approaches considered before choosing. Items can be plain strings (backward compatible) or structured objects with pros/cons analysis for ADR generation.

chosen.description: The option selected and why it was preferred over alternatives.

motivation_links.description: Traceability from decision to motivation layer: what goals, risks, assumptions, and trade-offs drove it.

goals.description: Goals this decision serves or advances.

assumptions.description: Assumptions this decision depends on being true.

questions.description: Domain competency questions (QN###) that drove this decision.

inquiries.description: Governance inquiries (INQ###) that drove or are resolved by this decision. Distinct from questions - inquiries are temporary governance concerns, questions are permanent domain knowledge requirements.

change_item.description: A single change introduced by a decision. Blueprint element change with versioning impact.

kind.description: Change type: add→minor, modify→minor/major, deprecate→minor, remove/rename/split/merge→major.

target.description: SpecPath to the affected blueprint element (e.g. rules.classification.CR003).

before.description: State before the change (snapshot or description). Required for modify/remove.

after.description: State after the change (snapshot or description). Required for add/modify.

semver.description: Versioning impact of this specific change.

notes.description: Explanation of why this change is needed.

impact_declaration.description: Author's declaration of affected entities: direct changes and transitive ripple hints.

direct.description: Entities directly changed by this decision.

bounded_contexts.title: Bounded contexts
bounded_contexts.description: Bounded contexts (BC###) this decision changes as a whole, by arch id - e.g. a decision that splits a context or moves its boundary. A typed reference: an id no arch file declares is a cross-reference error.

services.title: Services
services.description: Architecture services (SVC###) this decision changes directly, by arch id - e.g. a decision that replaces a service's runtime or retires it. A typed reference: an id no arch file declares is a cross-reference error.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Third-party packages (PKG###) this decision changes directly, by the id their `packages:` declaration carries - e.g. a decision that adopts, replaces or upgrades a package, or renews its license. A typed reference: an id no arch file declares is a cross-reference error.

ui.description: UI elements directly affected by this decision.

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure resources (IR###) directly affected by this decision - e.g. a hosting-modernization ADR that re-platforms a store. Puts infra into decision impact analysis (v2.7.7, additive). Parallels the metamodel `impacts_links` shape.

environments.description: Deployment environments (ENV###) directly affected - e.g. a decision that adds a DR environment or changes a binding for staging. Additive (v2.7.7).

transitive_hints.description: Human hints about expected ripple effects beyond direct impacts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conditions for this decision to be considered fully implemented. Free strings for low barrier.

must_pass_tests.description: Tests that must pass (names or free strings).

new_tests_to_add.description: New tests that need to be created.

reviews_required.description: Reviews or approvals needed before landing.

decision_links.description: External references and decision chain links.

related.description: Related decisions or ADRs (URLs or IDs). Relevance without replacement - use supersedes/superseded_by when one decision actually replaces another.

supersedes.description: Decisions this one replaces. Array supports many-to-one merge (multiple old decisions consolidated).

superseded_by.description: Decisions that replace this one. Array supports one-to-many split (one decision divided).

option.description: A structured decision option with description, pros, cons, and open questions. Used for ADR generation with full analysis per alternative.

name.description: Short name of the option (e.g. 'x-vector voice conversion', 'McAdams coefficient').

description.description: Detailed description of the option - technical approach, constraints, prerequisites.

pros.description: Advantages of this option. Each item is a self-contained benefit statement.

cons.description: Disadvantages, risks, or costs of this option. Each item is a self-contained concern.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that must be answered before this option can be chosen.

business_decision.description: BCC v5 Business Decision - a key rule or policy that governs the behaviour of one or more bounded contexts. NOT a data-level invariant (those live in rules.schema.yaml as Rule); NOT an ADR (DC### above). These are higher-level policy statements expressing "what we will / will not do" in the bounded context's domain.

id.description: Unique business decision identifier (e.g. BD001 or orders.BD001).

name.description: Short human-readable name. Used in displayId fallback when no context prefix is set.

description.description: Full statement of the decision. Free text; may be multi-paragraph.

domain_scope.description: The problem-space scope that owns this decision, as a kebab-case scope slug (e.g. billing, order-mgmt). Matched by name, not resolved as a typed reference. A single decision may apply to several scopes through `linked_contexts[]`.

linked_contexts.description: Other contexts this decision affects (cross-context policy).

linked_user_stories.description: User stories that motivated this decision.

version.description: Decision version for individual lifecycle tracking.

modeling_guidance.lesson: Use status open for a question with no proposed direction yet. Use proposed once a direction is put forward, and rfc while that direction circulates for comments before acceptance. Accepted records agreement; landed records implementation. Rejected or deprecated may end any stage. Status describes the decision lifecycle independently of discovery_stage, certainty and evidence. The required rationale.chosen remains a statement of the current position; for open, state that no direction is proposed yet.
